snippet.title: Harvest Skies: Crop Dusting Simulator - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4110140/Harvest_Skies_Crop_Dusting_Simulator

Build your crop-dusting empire from a single rusty biplane. Take contracts, mix chemicals, fly through wind and hazards. Then hire pilots, expand to new airfields, and grow your operation. See how far your skills can take you... and your luck.

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4110140/
🌐 Discord: https://discord.gg/WCDp3VZuYW
🦋 X: https://x.com/ProjectFlyerOne


Created by Digital Chiefs Studio. Trailer music composed and sound design by Leo Riskin.
